description: This Java class 'LiveSignalPubSubFactory' is a specialized factory for creating pub/sub components for live signals within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It extends an abstract pub/sub factory, uses streaming type information to determine topics, and provides factory methods for instantiation based on actor system contexts.

classes.name: LiveSignalPubSubFactory
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractPubSubFactory, tailored for live signals, providing methods to instantiate and configure pub/sub instances based on actor context.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate LiveSignalPubSubFactory with a given ActorContext.

methods.name: getStreamingTypeTopic
methods.description: Private static method that derives a set of PubSub topics based on the provided Signal, utilizing streaming type information.

methods.name: topicExtractor
methods.description: Private static method returning a PubSubTopicExtractor configured to extract topics from signals using the streaming type.
